description: Local Ollama coding assistant built into Aethrix.
trustDescription: Repository reading is available in restricted mode. Trust the workspace to enable file edits and terminal commands.
modelDescription: Installed Ollama model used for local coding.
contextDescription: Model context window. Larger values need more memory.
approvalDescription: Approval mode for Aethrix actions in this project: ask first, automatically apply file edits, or automatically apply file edits and run commands. Workspace trust and file boundaries still apply.
symbolDescription: Symbol path passed to WinDbg and dump analyzers. Empty uses Microsoft symbols with a private local cache.
